title: An Evaluation of BioMime™ - Sirolimus Eluting Coronary Stent in a Multi- Centre Study.
brief_summary: This is a multi centre, prospective trial. 250 patients will be enrolled in the study.(10 patients per centre involving approximately 25 centres). Patients will be followed up clinically for twelve months post-procedure at 1 month, 6 months \& 12 months. All patients will have a repeat angiography at 8 months. Clinical follow-up will be maintained for years 3 \& 5 post-implant.
study_population: The study population will consist of 250 patients with an obstructive coronary artery disease with few exclusion criteria.
